technical.summary: ABT shows oversold conditions (RSI, Stoch, Williams %R) but lacks bullish confirmation; bearish structure (below all MAs, negative CMF, three black crows) with neutral sector momentum makes this a poor swing entry despite potential mean-reversion setup.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market fear (43 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and mixed sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 211 crisis regime, rising DXY, NFP event today) creates severe headwinds for ABT; earnings in 40 days adds moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9/14 oversold + Williams %R oversold create mean-reversion setup with support at 90.80 nearby, offering asymmetric risk/reward if macro stress temporarily eases.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish structure (price below all MAs, three black crows, negative CMF/MACD, no bullish confirmation) combined with crisis-regime macro (inverted yield curve, VIX spike, NFP event today, earnings in 40 days) makes this a trap for mean-reversion traders.
